notes: The rear part (--part rear) was written and run by the round 17 R04 builder; recorded as ready by the orchestrator. Speed (2026-10-02): the clump builders were the slow part of every R03 and R04 plan (H36 about 4.4 min, H34 about 5.5 min per build on an idle machine, far more when Blender slots compete), so a 12 variant plan took about 90 minutes. art/species-construction/author_fan_clumps_field_fast.py (with fan_clumps_front_fast.py, fan_clumps_front_run_fast.py and fan_clumps_fast_common.py) is the same builder with the same arguments, spec and levers, about 4 times quicker (H34 about 1.4 min, H36 about 1.0 min): the nearest axis sample comes from a matrix product inside provably relevant tiles, voxels already at the band skip the rest of the arithmetic, each clump is blurred and unioned only over the box that holds it, and the mesh counts, speck and island removal and vertex transforms are numpy instead of Python loops over bmesh vertices. Equivalence against the slow builds (art/species-construction/fan_clumps_compare.py): H34 against head-2261 vertices 1035843 against 1035845, mean surface distance 2e-8 figure heights, max 3.9e-4; H36 against head-2279 identical vertex and face counts, mean 0, max 1.5e-5, same pale faces. The slow script and the starters tool-R03-pinned.json and r17-R04-pinned.json stay as they are (pinned to the bytes that built the baseline); use tool-R03-fast.json, which carries both H34 and H36 on the fast script, for new plans.

v2Reason: Round 21 reader check rejected every H36 candidate 3 to 0 for straight cut planes (flat rectangular plates beside each eye in the front view, a ladder of slabs along the fan's back edge in the side view). Cause: not the speed-up (the slow builder, author_fan_clumps_field.py, on the same H35 makes the same planes; head-2465 vs head-2386 look alike). In fan_clumps_front_fast.py build_wing the strip cut a vertical wall at the strip inner edge (strip_weight ramp .008 against a cut at the mid-surface, around line 240), the core was a slab with hard outline walls (sd2 at ~line 455) filled front to back by column so it left flat rungs between the rear spikes, and the cup carve (~line 520) cut a vertical rim wall around the polygon. Fix (new versioned files, originals untouched): author_fan_clumps_field_fast_v2.py, fan_clumps_front_run_fast_v2.py, fan_clumps_front_fast_v2.py (fan_clumps_fast_common.py unchanged): strip_ramp_in, strip_depth_ramp, strip_max_depth; core thinned to nothing at its outline and away from the coat (core_feather, core_cover_reach, core_rear_overlap, core_inset .03 passed by --p); cup_dish (carve depth rises to nothing at the rim); seam_blur bands at the strip edge and cup rim; ceiling_blend bevel; H34 gets --core-feather .03. Starter: recipes/tool-R03-fast-v2.json (assembled-2475, packet loop/packets/assembled-2475, one solid). Not fully clean: a thin dark crevice along each wing in head-top and one flat tip plate in the side view remain, the pale tufts read softer and less cupped than the baseline's, and the old front-fan root band beside the eyes shows a faint L crease. A reader check has to confirm before use.
